MCP_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Generate a separate random token for your admin Muse connector. Save it for the Bearer token field in Muse.

CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generate a separate 32-byte random key (64 hexadecimal characters). Back it up in your password manager and reuse it on every deployment of this Worker.

MUSE_SDK_TOKEN.description: Your Muse Gadget SDK token from gadgets.muse.ai. The browser setup uses this Worker secret when minting device credentials.
